div.div: مَفَارِخُ , a pl. of which the sing. is not mentioned, (TA,) Places where birds have [or produce by hatching] young ones. (K.) [Such a place may be called, accord. to analogy, ↓ مُفْرَخٌ (which may be the sing. of مَفَارِخُِ) and ↓ مُفَرَّخُ .]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
